summary: Frontend-only PWA install feature verified end-to-end. Manifest, service worker, icons, meta tags all correct. Banner appears via synthetic beforeinstallprompt, dismiss/close buttons write localStorage timestamp and hide banner. Reload within 24h correctly suppresses banner. iOS Safari UA path shows banner after ~2.5s and opens the 3-step iOS instruction sheet on Install click.

ui_bugs.issue: The 'Made with Emergent' badge (position:fixed bottom:16px right:16px, z-index:9999) overlays the bottom-right of the install banner on 390px mobile viewport. It covers/partially occludes the 'Not now' button area, so real user taps in that region may hit the badge (opens app.emergent.sh) instead of dismissing. Banner z-index is 60 while badge is 9999. Consider raising banner z-index above the badge or offsetting the banner (e.g., bottom-20/bottom-24 on mobile) so the badge does not intercept taps.
